name: Balsamic Basil Chicken
desc: Balsamic-Dijon marinated chicken thighs seared in one skillet, then roasted with zucchini and cherry tomatoes.

source.title: Balsamic Basil Chicken
source.evidence: Same ingredients and amounts (1/4 cup plus 2 tbsp olive oil, 3 tbsp balsamic, 1 tbsp Dijon, 2 lb bone-in thighs, 1 large zucchini, 1 pint cherry tomatoes) and the same sear-then-425°F method.

ingredients.raw: 1/4 cup plus 2 tbsp extra-virgin olive oil, divided
1/2 tsp freshly ground black pepper, divided
1 large zucchini, cut into half moons
1/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan, for serving (optional)

steps: In a large bowl, whisk together 1/4 cup olive oil, the balsamic vinegar, and the Dijon. Add the chicken thighs and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes or up to 4 hours.
Heat the remaining 2 tbsp oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat. Shake the excess marinade off the chicken and season all over with most of the salt and pepper.
Lay the chicken in the pan skin side down and sear until golden, about 6 minutes. Flip and sear the other side, about 6 minutes more.
Scatter the zucchini and tomatoes around the chicken and season them with the remaining salt and pepper.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake until the thickest part of the chicken reads 165°F, about 15 minutes.
Garnish with Parmesan and basil and serve.

references.title: Balsamic Basil Chicken
